summary: The imperfective paradox ('John was crossing the street' true while 'John crossed the street' is false) over an axiomatized event mereology: events with subevent preorder, culminates, result_state, instant-valued time_of on a linearly ordered Time, indices as World*Time. PROG rendered extensionally (non-culminating subevent at speech time, Parsons-style), PERF as past event with result_state, PST as bare past event. A scenario section proves the paradox datum (progressive_is_true, perfective_is_false) from interruption hypotheses plus an event-uniqueness axiom; an entailment section proves simple past -> past progressive via an added subinterval-style axiom (progressive_subevent, with an in-file countermodel showing its necessity), and attempts the non-entailment against culmination-free PST, whose key lemma simple_past_false is Admitted with an explicit countermodel showing it is FALSE as stated (PST omits culmination). Dowty's own solutions appear only as unproven sketches: PROG_DOWTY (intended_completion primitive) and PROG_MODAL (accessible worlds, but the completion clause is not world-indexed, making the modal quantification vacuous). Imports MontagueFragment for Entity.

sources.citation: Dowty, D. (1979). Word Meaning and Montague Grammar, ch. 3 (the imperfective paradox and the inertia-worlds progressive). Reidel.
Dowty, D. (1977). Toward a semantic analysis of verb aspect and the English 'imperfective' progressive. Linguistics and Philosophy 1:45-77.
Parsons, T. (1990). Events in the Semantics of English (hold/culminate distinction — the analysis the file's PROG actually implements). MIT Press.

definitions_mapped.coq: PROG (exists e_prog e_full, VP x e_full /\ subevent e_prog e_full /\ ~culminates e_prog e_full /\ time_of e_prog = speech_time)
definitions_mapped.note: extensional Parsons-style hold/culminate substitute for Dowty's inertia-worlds modal operator; removes the intensionality that is Dowty's whole point, altering which claims are provable

definitions_mapped.source: perfective past of a telic VP

definitions_mapped.coq: Time : Type with lt (trans, irrefl, total); time_of : Event -> Time; Index := World * Time
definitions_mapped.source: Dowty 1979's interval semantics with speech/event times
definitions_mapped.note: instants replace intervals; each event gets a single instant

definitions_mapped.source: event-part and culmination structure (Parsons; Landman stages)

definitions_mapped.source: the content of Dowty's solution: accessible worlds are those where events continue without interruption

theorems.name: progressive_is_true
theorems.source_claim: the paradox datum, first half: 'John was crossing the street' true at (w0, t_speech) in the interruption scenario (Dowty 1977/1979 motivating example)

theorems.name: perfective_is_false
theorems.source_claim: the paradox datum, second half: PERF false at the same index
theorems.note: rests on the global axiom crossing_event_unique plus section hypotheses no_completion/was_interrupted; PERF-falsity nearly follows from ~result_state by uniqueness, so this is a consistency demonstration, not a deep theorem

theorems.name: perfective_entails_progressive
theorems.source_claim: the standard aspectual entailment: simple past -> past progressive
theorems.note: needs the added axiom progressive_subevent; the file documents a countermodel showing the entailment fails without it — a NEEDS_ASSUMPTION finding promoted to an axiom (a tacit subinterval-property premise of the informal literature)

theorems.name: perfective_entails_progressive_v2
theorems.source_claim: duplicate of perfective_entails_progressive (identical statement and proof strategy)

theorems.name: progressive_true
theorems.source_claim: counterexample scenario: 'John was reading a book' true

theorems.name: simple_past_false
theorems.source_claim: counterexample scenario: 'John read a book' false
theorems.note: in-file comment gives an explicit countermodel (Event:=unit, time_of:=0, ...) proving the statement unprovable because PST lacks culmination; the file names the two repairs (culmination conjunct in telic PST, or a temporal hypothesis) — a genuine finding about a hidden premise

theorems.name: progressive_does_not_entail_perfective
theorems.source_claim: the imperfective paradox as a non-entailment
theorems.note: Qed but Print Assumptions includes the Admitted simple_past_false, so it does not count as a result under rubric section 3; the non-entailment against PERF is however established by progressive_is_true + perfective_is_false in the first section

evidence: The paradox datum is established against the culmination-based PERF: progressive_is_true and perfective_is_false both Qed at the same index (lines 123-157), from interruption hypotheses plus the crossing_event_unique axiom.

The core progressive is 'changed': an extensional subevent/non-culmination analysis (lines 53-59) stands in for Dowty's inertia-worlds modal operator, which appears only as the theorem-free defective sketch PROG_MODAL (lines 189-194, completion clause not world-indexed).

The non-entailment against PST is stated but not established: simple_past_false is Admitted (line 350) with an in-file countermodel showing it FALSE as written, and progressive_does_not_entail_perfective inherits that admission.

perfective_entails_progressive is Qed only via the added axiom progressive_subevent (lines 236-238), whose necessity the file documents with a countermodel — a tacit premise of the informal presentations made explicit.

Coq check: Axiom inside a Section stays a global assumption generalized over section variables (verified with Print Assumptions on a test file), so all 9 propositional axioms are genuine global commitments.
simplifications: instants for Dowty's intervals; one instant per event
culmination as a primitive result_state predicate
event mereology reduced to a refl/trans subevent preorder
PROG_DOWTY leaves intention as an unanalyzed primitive
omissions: the inertia-worlds constraint (the actual content of Dowty's solution) — PROG_MODAL has no theorems and its accessibility relation is unconstrained
intensional (world-indexed) VP meanings, without which the modal solution cannot even be stated non-vacuously
interval semantics and the subinterval property that grounds the activity/accomplishment distinction
additions: progressive_subevent axiom with documented necessity countermodel
the FALSE-as-stated diagnosis of simple_past_false naming the hidden culmination premise of telic simple past

determination_rationale: The only formalization is partial with a changed core: Dowty's modal progressive is replaced by an extensional Parsons-style hold/culminate analysis, and the paradox is recovered only after re-founding — an added subinterval-style axiom (progressive_subevent) for the entailment direction, event-uniqueness axioms for the falsity direction, and the discovery that a culmination-free simple past makes the non-entailment outright false (simple_past_false Admitted with countermodel). Dowty's actual inertia-worlds theory remains unformalized here (PROG_MODAL is a vacuous sketch over a non-world-indexed VP type). This is a pilot-file lower bound on the theory, not a diagnosis of Dowty 1979 itself; a proper intensionalized formalization could plausibly reach determination 2.

artifact_classes.description: no native event mereology or interval-temporal structure: both are axiomatized (subevent preorder, linear instant order, culminates_sub); and the fragment's extensional VP type (Entity -> Event -> Prop, not world-indexed) makes Dowty's inertia-worlds operator unstatable non-vacuously — PROG_MODAL's completion clause is world-independent

source_gap.detail: Two tacit premises of the informal literature surface: (a) 'simple past -> past progressive' requires that every complete event have a non-culminating subevent at the same time (progressive_subevent; a subinterval-property analogue Dowty states for activities but the entailment needs for accomplishments too — the file proves the entailment fails without it); (b) the non-entailment 'progressive does not entail simple past' requires simple past of a telic VP to entail culmination — with a culmination-free PST the claimed non-entailment is FALSE (explicit countermodel in the simple_past_false comment). Note: the primary source is barely available (Dowty 1979 front matter only; Dowty 1977 absent), so the source mapping is judged from the canonical presentation, not page-by-page.

notes: Record produced by the batch audit sweep of 2026-09-05; pre-atlas pilot file predating the zero-axiom discipline (12 signature Parameters, 9 propositional Axioms — including three declared inside Sections, which Coq keeps as global axioms generalized over section variables, verified by Print Assumptions test).
